intro: Dawnwatcher Selgorm is a human representative of the Argent Dawn stationed upon the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. Acting as an observer and liaison in the night elven capital, he monitors reports of shadowy cult activity and dark threats stirring across northern Kalimdor.

p: While the Argent Dawn focuses heavily on the undead scourge festering in the Eastern Plaguelands, their vigilance extends anywhere ancient evil takes root. Dawnwatcher Selgorm stands watch in Darnassus, bridging the gap between the insular night elves and the broader crusade against malevolence. From the Craftsmen's Terrace, he gathers intelligence on emerging threats in Kalimdor's wilderness, enlisting capable Alliance travelers to strike at cultists and dark powers before their influence can corrupt the realm.
